📑 Main Menu Layout

                    

                        ড্র্যাগ করে সাজাও। Main = উপরে ট্যাব বার। Sub = Main-এর নিচে ড্রপডাউন।
                        Sub → Sub = সাবমেনুর ভিতরে নেস্টেড। Save করলে সব ডিভাইস লেআউট মনে রাখবে (এই ব্রাউজারে)।
                    

                    

                        
                        
                        
                    

                    
    
                    
    Tip: Level বদলালে Parent বেছে নাও (Sub / Nested-এর জন্য)।

                            🏢 Your Businesses
                            
                        
    
                        
    
                        
    
                            Join another business:
                            
                            
                        
    
                    
    

                    
    
                        New business owner: tap "Create business account" — you'll be asked for a business name and get a Business Code, share the code with your staff.
    
                        Staff / other devices: sign in, then enter the Business Code your owner shared and tap "Join business".
    
                        Multiple businesses: join several, then tap "Set Active" on the one you want to sync live. Only the active business syncs at any moment.
    
                        Everyone who joins the same code sees and edits the same live data. Use Team tab for device-level roles (Admin/Manager/Staff/Viewer). Cloud-side per-user permissions can be tightened later via Firestore rules.
